one_line: The video uses a split-screen analysis of Sydney Sweeney's face to explain that lip aesthetics are about facial proportions, promoting Refina AI to preview these changes.

hook.what_happens: A portrait of Sydney Sweeney is shown with the question of whether the viewer thinks their lips are too thin.
hook.why_it_works: It targets a common cosmetic insecurity using a highly recognizable celebrity face.

shots.description: Unmodified portrait of Sydney Sweeney with introductory text.
Measurement lines appear on the portrait to show facial proportions.
Split-screen comparison showing thin vs. full lips on the same face.
Highlighting the chin area on the portrait.
Interactive slider demonstrating the range of lip volumes on one face.
Side-by-side comparison of the full face with different lip sizes.
Text-only instruction screen prompting the viewer to try an exercise.
CTA screen with a search bar mockup for Refina AI.

devices.name: split-screen slider
devices.what_it_is: A vertical dividing line showing before/after states.
devices.used_for: Comparing thin and full lip volumes dynamically.

devices.name: search bar mockup
devices.used_for: Directing users to search for the product.

onscreen_text.text: The lower third is read from here
They are the line the lower face is measured from.
Your eye never measures a feature alone.
It measures the gaps around it.
Move the lip line and every gap moves.
NOSE BASE TO LIP EDGE, MEASURED
One. The gap between nose and lip.
Full lips make it short. Thin lips, long.
The chin isn't what changed either.
Here is that range, on one face.
Watch the gap, not the lips.

transcript.text: Think your lips are too thin? This is the mouth you're picturing. And it was never about size.
Lips are not a feature. They are the line the lower face is measured from.
Your eye never measures a feature alone. It measures the gaps around it. Move the lip line and every gap moves.
One. The gap between nose and lip. Full lips make it short. Thin lips, long. The nose isn't what changed.
Two. The chin reads stronger. The chin isn't what changed either.
Here is that range, on one face. Watch the gap, not the lips.
Now turn it. A front photograph hides it.
None of this means fuller is better. It means lips are load-bearing. On many faces, less is the change.
Do it now. Roll your lips inward and hold. Watch your chin arrive.
You will not get that mouth. See it on your own face first. A preview, not a promise. Search Refina AI.

narrative_arc: Challenge the viewer's perception of thin lips.
Introduce the concept of facial proportions and 'gaps'.
Demonstrate how changing lip size alters the perception of the nose and chin.
Provide an interactive physical exercise for the viewer to experience the effect.
Introduce the product as a tool to preview these changes on the viewer's own face.

cta.what: Search Refina AI to preview lip changes on your own face.

subjects.name: Sydney Sweeney
subjects.role: Model used for facial proportion analysis

what_makes_it_work: Uses scientific-sounding terminology ('load-bearing', 'lower third') to build authority.
Engages the viewer with a physical interactive test ('Roll your lips inward').
Leverages a highly recognizable celebrity face to maintain visual interest.

animations.name: Measurement Line Draw
animations.what_moves: Horizontal alignment lines with text labels
animations.purpose: Establishes anatomical reference points (nose base, lip edge, chin) to explain facial proportions.
animations.reusable_as: Highlighting dimensions or alignment on any product or face diagram.

animations.name: Gap Highlight Box
animations.what_moves: A rectangular outline box around the mouth area
animations.purpose: Focuses viewer attention on the spatial gap between the nose and chin.
animations.reusable_as: Framing key areas of interest in technical or educational videos.

animations.name: Split Screen Comparison
animations.what_moves: A vertical divider line separating thin and full lip edits
animations.purpose: Directly contrasts the visual impact of thin versus full lips on the same face.
animations.reusable_as: Before/after comparisons for cosmetic, editing, or restoration services.

animations.name: Interactive Slider Demo
animations.what_moves: A slider handle moving horizontally, dynamically changing lip volume
animations.purpose: Simulates an interactive app experience showing real-time morphing.
animations.reusable_as: Demonstrating software sliders, filters, or adjustable product features.

animations.name: Profile Merge
animations.what_moves: Side profile and front-facing portraits sliding together
animations.purpose: Transitions from a 3D profile view back to a flat front-facing comparison.
animations.reusable_as: Merging multiple perspectives of a subject into a single frame.

animations.name: Search Bar Typing
animations.what_moves: Text characters appearing sequentially in a search input field
animations.purpose: Simulates typing a brand name into a search engine for a call to action.
animations.reusable_as: Any search-based call to action or typing simulation.
animations.would_need_building: Typewriter text input effect inside a styled search bar component

animation_language_summary.how_things_enter: Elements fade in place or draw on as vector lines.
animation_language_summary.how_things_leave: Elements fade out or are wiped away by transitions.
animation_language_summary.how_scenes_change: Hard cuts or sliding panel transitions.
animation_language_summary.what_stays_still: The central portrait of the model remains anchored.
animation_language_summary.rhythm: Deliberate and educational, pausing on static diagrams before animating comparisons.

what_we_should_steal: Interactive Slider Demo: Highly engaging way to show real-time morphing or adjustments.
Measurement Line Draw: Clean, scientific way to annotate and explain visual proportions.
